title: MCP Phase 5 Local Session Auth and Tier Authorization v1 — Rig Relay
files_changed: rig_relay/protocols/mcp/server.py (added _session_token, _session_token_fingerprint, _require_auth, _validate_auth; reordered call_tool and call_tool_sync to check auth before tool lookup; wired session_token into _handle_jsonrpc tools/call)
rig_relay/protocols/mcp/models.py (added 3 refusal codes: AUTH_REQUIRED, INVALID_SESSION_TOKEN, UNAUTHORIZED_TIER)

auth_model.fingerprint: SHA256(token):16 — safe for evidence, unusable for auth
auth_model.transport: JSON-RPC params.session_token — stdio-compatible, no headers needed
auth_model.activation: require_auth=True at server construction. Default False for backward compatibility with existing tests. serve_stdio() and hosted deployments will require True.

token_handling.refusal_shows_fingerprint: invalid session_token refusal includes fingerprint (safe, not the token) for debugging

pipeline_order.step_0_5: Authentication — validate session token, refuse before tool lookup if missing/invalid
pipeline_order.step_1: Unknown tool — JSON-RPC error if tool not in registry

remaining_seams.hosted_oauth: OAuth/bearer token support deferred. MCPToolAuthMetadata has bearer_supported and oauth_supported flags but no implementation.
remaining_seams.unknown_tool_format: Still returns JSON-RPC error rather than structured refusal.
remaining_seams.common_envelope: input_hash, output_hash, payload_schema, artifact_refs, producer, trace_id still missing from responses.

mcp_security_implications.before: MCP tools/call was anonymous — any client connected via stdio could invoke any read-only tool without identification. No session token, no auth check.
mcp_security_implications.after: With require_auth=True, every tools/call requires a valid session token before any other check. Token validated with constant-time comparison. Refusals do not leak raw tokens. Token fingerprint (not token) appears in evidence. Auth refusals persist via receipt_store. Tier authorization remains enforced (mutation/git-release permanently blocked).
